module: Flowgraph node 'Compare' (logic category). Compares inputs A and B (type any) with a comparison function chosen in the editor (list from getComparisonOps(), sorted by name). Outputs: flow, flow 'true', flow 'false' and the hidden bool 'value'. If A or B is nil for an operator other than == and ~=, an error event is logged and all outputs go to false.
notes: In _onPropertyChanged the log comment references a nonexistent variable 'value', with no effect (commented-out line).
If flow is not connected, pinOut.flow simply reflects the value of pinIn.flow.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: Sorts the comparison operators by name and selects the first one by default.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Properties panel: dropdown of comparison functions.

refreshFunction.desc: Updates compFunc from the chosen comparison; if absent, installs an empty function and reports the error 'Invalid comparison'.

_onPropertyChanged.desc: Called when a property changes; reruns refreshFunction.

_onSerialize.desc: Saves opSymbol of the current comparison.

_onDeserialized.desc: Finds the comparison via opSymbol (or the old field data.comparisonFunc) then calls refreshFunction.

work.desc: Computes value = compFunc(A, B); flow follows the flow input, true = value, false = not value. nil case described above.
